slices.title: Measure first: render, churn and cold-open budgets
slices.summary: Adds the measurement layer before any behaviour change: a render-budget vitest (MarkdownBlockView and AnswerRegion mounts, parse count per token), a stream-churn vitest (transcript setItem counts and sizes, uiEvents length, taskSteps identity) and a synthetic-fixture Playwright spec whose budget JSON is asserted only when PERF_ENFORCE=1. Test code only; no runtime change.

slices.title: Incremental Markdown parse and keyed node list
slices.summary: Makes per-token Markdown rendering incremental: parseMarkdownIncremental freezes sealed prefix blocks (FROZEN_TAIL_BLOCKS = 2) so only the trailing block re-renders, ChatMessages keys its node list by nodeKey instead of an unkeyed For, and the node registry gains an additive renderLive accessor. The old path stays behind VITE_CHAT_RENDER_LEGACY=true for one release.

slices.title: Throttle snapshot writes and remove per-token churn
slices.summary: Routes the per-flush local transcript snapshot through createSnapshotWriter (at most one write per second while streaming; flushed on terminal, visibilitychange, pagehide, thread switch and cleanup), makes upsertTaskStep a no-op on shallow-equal steps and keeps only the first message.delta per turn in the Trace. Terminal writes stay synchronous and the ZDR, temporary and foreign-thread guards still run before every write.

slices.title: Frame-batched chunk deltas (conditional)
slices.summary: Coalesces chunk deltas per animation frame inside chat-client dispatchEvent case 'chunk' through a new delta-coalescer, flushing before any non-chunk event and on done, stopped, error and abort (hidden-tab setTimeout(100) fallback). Built only if the S1 spec shows more than one flush per frame.
slices.needs_external: owner sign-off on the D5 numeric trigger (S1 must show more than one flush per frame)
test_commands: pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/api/delta-coalescer.test.ts src/shared/api/chat-client.test.ts src/features/chat/components/use-chat-controller.resume-replay.test.ts

slices.title: Stale-chunk recovery with one reload and notice
slices.summary: Adds installChunkRecovery on vite:preloadError (production builds): one automatic reload inside a 30 s window tracked in sessionStorage, a StaleBuildNotice on the second failure, and no reload while a registered guard reports a dirty composer (text, streaming or pending attachments). Installed in index.tsx before render, with a Playwright project chunk-recovery.

slices.title: Parallel cold-open thread load (conditional)
slices.summary: Runs getThreadMessages concurrently with listChatThreads in loadThread, drops the duplicate getChatThreadTranscript call once ChatThreadSession.updatedAt is verified, and single-flights listChatThreads. Built only if the S1 request budget is missed; readSavedAnswer and the BFF /transcript route stay for their other callers.
slices.needs_external: owner sign-off on the D5 numeric trigger (S1 request budget)

slices.title: CSS containment for off-screen turns (conditional)
slices.summary: Adds a content-visibility: auto rule with contain-intrinsic-size to non-latest chat messages in global.css, guarded by a rule-presence test; deleting the rule is the rollback. Built only per the D5 trigger.
slices.needs_external: owner sign-off on the D5 numeric trigger

slices.title: Tail-first paged ListConversation across planes (conditional)
slices.summary: Adds opt-in tail-first paging to the transcript read across session-core, model-gateway and the BFF: add-only ListConversationRequest.limit=6 and before_message_id=7 with ListConversationResponse.has_more=2, a clamped query that keeps audience_ceiling in the same WHERE, and validated limit and before forwarding. limit=0 (the default) keeps every other caller byte-identical; no migration; conditional per D5.
slices.needs_external: DEC-29 owner ruling on cursor and field ownership (D4); DEC-39 integrator assigns the proto tag numbers (proposed 6, 7 and 2); owner sign-off on the D5 numeric trigger
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core" && go build ./... && go test ./internal/sessionreview/...

slices.title: SPA paged transcript with load-earlier (conditional)
slices.summary: Consumes S8 in the SPA: getThreadMessages takes limit and beforeMessageId and returns hasMore, loadThread opens on a 100-message tail, and loadEarlier() prepends older turns with a scroll anchor; readSavedAnswer reads a 4-message tail. Behind VITE_CHAT_PAGED_TRANSCRIPT; the 120-turn local snapshot is unchanged.
slices.needs_external: DEC-29 owner ruling (cursor and field ownership) recorded before S8 and S9 build

slices.title: JS-virtualised timeline, last resort (optional)
slices.summary: Adds an in-house transcript window (transcript-window.ts with measured heights) that always renders the streaming turn, the last N turns and the focused turn, with aria-setsize and aria-posinset for screen readers. Behind VITE_CHAT_VIRTUALIZE (default off) and built only as the last resort.
slices.needs_external: owner sign-off on the D5 numeric trigger; Solid 2.0 rc and @tanstack/solid-virtual compatibility are undetermined and must be decided before build
